greet_all_npcs.title: Have you met everyone in town yet?
lines: If a newcomer doesn't even know the faces in town, nobody can help each other when something happens.
It's a small town. Everyone getting to know each other is better in more ways than one.
Whenever you have time, say hello to the people you run into. Once you've met them all, let me know.

try_fishing_rod.title: You ought to get a fishing rod
lines: Anyone who's come to this town ought to have a fishing rod, wouldn't you say?
Buy one at my shop. It's 500 gold. Not so expensive.
Sea or river, you'll lose track of time just casting a line.

welcome_income_boost.title: Wishing you good business
lines: I heard you've started a new restaurant.
It reminds me of when I first opened my shop in this town. There wasn't a single customer, so I dusted all day long.
Write to me again once your total income passes 300 gold. I'll set aside something that may help, however small.

try_harvest_potato.title: Want to try harvesting a potato?
lines: Hey, you bought potato seeds but haven't planted them yet, right? I can tell, you know.
I started with potatoes too when I first opened the shop. They're the least likely to fail.
Just plant them and water them well. You'd be surprised how good harvesting feels.

try_harvest_corn.title: Try growing corn too
lines: Have you planted corn yet? The seeds that came in this time are unusually plump.
It takes a bit of work, but the satisfaction when it's fully grown is something else.
Grow some and tell me what you think. I'm curious, honestly.

try_harvest_lettuce.title: Lettuce grows fast
lines: You haven't grown lettuce yet, have you? It's actually the fastest-growing crop at our place.
I know how it is, putting off farming because you're busy. But lettuce really is quick.
Just plant it once. You'll see right away that it's not hard.

try_pork.title: Want to try handling some pork?
lines: Helping out at the ranch, I've noticed there's hardly an ingredient easier to cook than pork.
Having one on the restaurant menu would make customers happy, I bet. I guarantee it.
Don't stress about it, just give it a try. As for Belje... well, no need to go into details, right?

try_beef.title: Try handling some beef too
lines: Give beef a try too. It takes a lot of effort, but people react really well when you cook it.
I picked these things up naturally working at the ranch. The first time is the hard part, after that it's quick.
If you need anything, just say so. I know ranch work better than anyone.

try_mackerel.title: Ever caught a mackerel?
lines: Mackerel, eh. Not sure if you've caught one. It's not hard as long as you have a rod.
Just stand on the beach in this town and cast, and they bite readily. A perfect fish for beginners.
Go catch one. That feel in your hands, you won't forget it easily.

try_salmon.title: How about catching a salmon?
lines: Care to catch a salmon too? It takes a bit more effort than mackerel.
Marin's been bringing them in quite well lately. No reason you can't.
Take it slow, don't rush your cast. That'll do it.

try_squid.title: Squid is a bit tricky
lines: Squid is a bit tricky, and most folks find it hard to catch.
Still, once you catch one, it's quite fun. Even Marin struggled at first.
Feel free to brag to me a little when you do. It should feel pretty good.

try_serve_dish.title: Ever served a dish to a customer?
lines: It's been a while since you opened the restaurant. Have you properly served a customer yet?
That's how business is. Your first customer is the most nerve-wracking, and after that you just keep doing it.
Send out a single dish. I still remember that pride myself.

try_harvest_berry.title: Want to pick some berries?
lines: You've only been farming, so you've never picked berries, right? You don't plant them, just pick what's already growing, so it's much easier.
There's a bush near the pond across from the restaurant. I pick a few now and then when I pass by, and eat them.
It'll feel different from growing them in a field. Go pick some.
